_note: REAL DATA — sourced from publicly reported enforcement/inspection activity in Hyderabad, 2024–2026, compiled from official social accounts (Commissioner of Food Safety Telangana @cfs_telangana, Cyberabad Municipal Corporation @CMC_Offcl, Malkajgiri Municipal Corporation) and cross-checked against news reporting (NDTV Food, New Indian Express, Siasat, and others). This is NOT FSSAI's Hygiene Rating Scheme data — it is a separate, distinct set of enforcement and municipal-inspection records. Two event types are tracked: 'rating' (a numeric municipal hygiene score, from CMC) and 'raid' (an enforcement inspection with no formal score, from CFS Telangana or Malkajgiri task forces). Inclusion means a public inspection or raid occurred — it does not by itself mean a restaurant is currently unsafe; some inspections found good compliance. This is also not a complete statutory log: GHMC alone reportedly ran 9,656 food-safety inspections in 2025, of which only a fraction were publicly named. Every event carries its own source citation.
